name: RC–B10–0156/2025 – After § 25 – Am 30
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on continuing the unwavering EU support for Ukraine, after three years of Russia’s war of aggression
part_text: 25b. Regrets the fact that circumvention of EU sanctions on assets is facilitated by tax havens and the lack of financial transparency; calls, in that regard, on the Commission to strengthen the fight against tax avoidance and financial secrecy;
